item.title: Development :: RE: New programming language MasterBASIC
item.description:
Author: undeveloper
Posted: Tue Nov 03, 2026 10:38 am (GMT 0)

Clearly some more clarity needed about the intention of the sticky directive here, before we all lose our sh*t again!

Personally, my interpretation was that it was specifically about AI-enabled homebrew games. I agree that it seems absurd to try and mandate a zero-AI policy around tooling. I very much doubt we're going to see a flood of "vibe-tools" as we have been seeing for games. People can judge for themselves whether a tool is useful for them and if they want to avoid it because it's written with AI that's up to them.

On a semi-related note though @Materion it's a shame your repo only includes a zip upload and not source code. Source would allow experienced folks to make a more reasoned opinion as to the quality of your project.

(EDIT: Also, note there is already a "MasterBasic" from circa 1990 associated with the ZX Spectrum, just to make you aware)

item.title: Development :: RE: New programming language MasterBASIC
item.description:
Author: fanglespangle
Posted: Tue Nov 03, 2026 10:06 am (GMT 0)

I think it should be clarified. AI generated content shouldn't be posted in the Development forum. It should be posted in the Main forum. I believe it was to prevent a wave of AI ports from drowning out the more traditional hand crafted stuff.

However, your second point about if something being made my hand with an AI built tool should be posted here... err... I dunno actually! If it is a fully developed program that can be run locally without the use of tokens to create games with then there is a clear degree of separation.

Personally, I applaud the fact that you used it to actually make your life easier and not to actually do the work for you. To me, it does feel very distinct from vibe coding. (EDIT - I know vibe coding isn't technically as straight forward as it does the work for you, but by and large that is how it's used. I generalised for the sake of brevity.)

But I also get that people do not want AI near anything that they do and with understandable reasons. I personally hate AI generated "art" and music... but I'm an artist and musician so of course I do. But I'm not a tool maker. I don't care how the tool was made, only that it does what I want it to so I can create MY art. However, tool making is its own art and someone like Sverx, Bock or Maxim who have made tools for master system development may take issue with the idea. If they saw someone using something made by AI, might they feel the same way I do when I see people use AI generated images? Only they could answer that really.

That isn't to say that what you did was bad or anything. Just that I hope I have communicated WHY people could take issue with the tool not being considered AI use. It is murky water for sure though.

item.title: Development :: New programming language MasterBASIC
item.description:
Author: Materion
Subject: New programming language MasterBASIC
Posted: Tue Nov 03, 2026 8:14 am (GMT 0)

Hello,

I created MasterBASIC language using Claude (LLM/AI) for game creation for Master System. It's BASIC that compiles into native Z80 machine code and creates .sms ROM file containing game. It's easy to learn and use. Currently compiler is built for LInux but right now I am compiling Windows version :).

you can find my github with googling (as new member I can't post links unfortunately) https://github.com/MaterzokMateusz/MasterBASIC/releases/tag/Release1.0 that contains zip file containing compiler, tools, examples. Also you can find PDFs with Reference and Beginner's Guide. There is also .vsix file for Visual Studio Code for syntax highlighting and code suggestions.

@EDIT

If someone can post links on this forum could you please reply to this post with link to my github? Would be very thankful :)
